facts.fact: UNESCO states that the Ministry of Information runs all television, radio and newspapers in Eritrea and that privately owned outlets effectively ceased to exist after a government ban in 2001; the document is dated 2026-01 and states the position as continuing.
facts.system: Government ban on privately owned media

systems.system: Penal Code Article 154 (false information discrediting state bodies)

note: Speech laws (Press Proclamation, Penal Code arts 154, 195, 301) are other with no one charged under them stated; Dawit Isaak's imprisonment since 2001 is not stated to be for anything said, so no penalty fact.
